questions.question: In Force 10 from Navarone, what is Ford’s commando named?
questions.note: 1978. He leads a mission into Yugoslavia. It is a sequel, not the original cliff-fortress raid.

questions.question: Force 10 from Navarone is a sequel to which film?
questions.note: The 1961 film blew the guns. Force 10 is a later commando job in the same war.

questions.question: Which Francis Ford Coppola film features Harrison Ford in a small role as Martin Stett?
choices: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
questions.note: Ford appears in Coppola’s 1974 paranoia thriller, starring Gene Hackman.

questions.question: In Sabrina (1995), what is Ford’s Linus Larrabee?
questions.answer: The workaholic brother who runs the company
choices: The workaholic brother who runs the company
questions.note: The 1954 film had the same job on a different face. Ford’s Linus falls for the chauffeur’s daughter after Paris.

questions.question: In Sabrina (1995), the chauffeur’s daughter comes home changed after a stay in which city?
questions.note: Sabrina Fairchild. Linus was supposed to keep her away from his playboy brother. That plan fails.

questions.question: Who directed the 1995 Sabrina remake?
questions.note: Pollack also made Tootsie and Out of Africa. 1995, from the Wilder film.

questions.question: In K-19: The Widowmaker, what does Ford’s Captain Vostrikov command?
questions.note: The reactor fails. He is the hard-ass sent to make the boat combat-ready.

questions.question: In K-19: The Widowmaker, what is Ford’s Soviet captain named?
questions.note: Alexei Vostrikov. The other senior officer wants the crew alive more than the mission.

questions.question: Who directed K-19: The Widowmaker?
questions.note: 2002. Bigelow later made The Hurt Locker and Zero Dark Thirty. Ford as a Soviet skipper is the odd bit.

questions.question: What is Ford’s rank-and-name role in Apocalypse Now?
questions.note: A short briefing-room part. The name is a nod to George Lucas, who was once meant to direct the film.
